dataset.name: Advanced soft-tissue sarcoma (POG570, 2020)
dataset.description: Soft-tissue sarcoma subset of the independent POG570 pan-cancer cohort with whole-transcriptome sequencing and linked overall survival.
dataset.cohort_context: Advanced or metastatic soft-tissue sarcomas spanning histologies represented in TCGA-SARC; this treatment-exposed cohort is not population-matched to primary tumors.

metadata.curation_note: Only samples annotated as Soft Tissue Sarcoma are requested from the public molecular profile. The complete source clinical payload remains in the audit bundle.

samples.sample_role: Advanced or metastatic soft-tissue sarcoma biopsy

expression.label: log2(RPKM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same Entrez identifier are averaged sample-wise before transformation; different identifiers are never merged implicitly.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Initial diagnosis as represented in the source cohort
